style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, cute satire with comic horror, bright alpine noon
motion_rule: EVERY second something big crosses the lens or fills it: the fan of coupons, the swarm of paper tags, her muzzle, the goat's horns. The lens is fully blanked six times. Grass and flowers never stop moving in the wind
camera_moves: wide; close-ups are brought by the animals and the flying tags, not the camera
character: a fluffy white alpaca, long neck, absurd fringe, buck teeth, huge expressive eyes, stand-up comic energy; one hoof pressed to her chest at the start
cast: the GOAT: grey-brown, big horns, square yellow pupils, plays a pan flute and holds an open fan of paper coupons; he never stops playing
props: TAGS: white paper price tags with butterfly wings, each with a big embossed currency sign and one large digit, no words. COUPONS: a plain paper fan in his hoof. FLOWERS: white and yellow, the tags lift off them
prop_continuity: the tags are butterflies until 7.2; then every wing flips digits-out, small sharp teeth cut through the paper, and from 8.2 they stay bitten into her coat
environment: sunlit Swiss alpine meadow, flowers, snowy peaks behind
lighting: blazing alpine noon, hard sun, crisp shadows; the horror comes from the teeth, never from the light

audio.language: no speech at all, no voice over
audio.sfx: a light fairground pan flute all clip, paper wings fluttering, wind in the grass, a sharp CLICK of the bite at 8.2, then the flute alone to the end
audio.pacing: the flute is even and cheerful the whole clip and does not change tempo after the bite

timeline.a: she strides at the lens until her muzzle fills the frame and slams a hoof to her chest, a solemn vow; wind whips the grass past her
the GOAT tops the hill; his open fan of coupons sweeps right across the lens and blanks the frame, the pan flute starts
her eyes glaze over; she swings her whole body around and her flank wipes the frame side to side as she walks after him
the meadow erupts: a swarm of white paper TAGS lifts off the flowers straight into the lens, blanking the frame twice, wings beating
she stretches her neck after them; one tag lands flat on the lens, covers the whole frame, then flutters off her nose
the tags settle over her in a thick coat, layer on layer, until only her happy squinting eyes are left in the frame
all the wings flip digits-out at once, the whole coat turning over like a wave; small sharp teeth cut through the paper
CLICK: every tag bites into her at once; she jolts up on all fours and the paper coat bursts outward and blanks the lens
her eyes blow wide in comic horror, the grin frozen on her face; the last tags rain down past the lens and the goat plays on behind her

must_appear: the fan of coupons crossing the lens, the swarm of paper butterflies filling the frame, tags covering her like a coat, wings flipping digits-out with teeth, her eyes wide in comic horror at the end
negative_prompt: letters, words, cyrillic, logos, readable text, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, dim light, people, hands, live insects, blood, gore, a second alpaca, slow motion, speed ramp, the alpaca frozen through a whole beat, an empty sky with nothing moving, accented Russian, grain
